# One Place Wellness

> Non-surgical facial rejuvenation in Naples, Florida, by Elizabeth Fox, M.D., a plastic surgeon who specialized in facelift surgery for more than 25 years and has treated more than 9,000 patients. 827 Myrtle Terrace, Naples, FL 34103, just off the Tamiami Trail (US 41), south of Pine Ridge Road. Phone 239-262-8585, email Oneplacewellness@gmail.com. Open Monday to Thursday, 9 am to 4 pm; closed Friday to Sunday. The first consultation is complimentary. Appointments are set by phone or by email request.

## Dr. Fox

- [Elizabeth Fox, M.D.](https://oneplacewellness.com/#dr-fox): plastic surgeon; more than 25 years of facelift surgery; more than 9,000 patients treated; knows the face in three dimensions. Radiesse chose her as a medical faculty advisor, to train other doctors. She pioneered a non-surgical neck lift: filler along the jaw, Botox for the neck bands, ThermiSmooth to tighten. Her patients range in age from 20 to 90.
- [Her approach](https://oneplacewellness.com/#shadows): restore, not overdo. Three to five millimeters of shadow can add up to five years to a face, so she reads the whole face (expression lines, a downturned mouth, the brow, the jaw) and softens the shadows that make a face look tired, sad or older, instead of simply adding volume.

## Treatments

- [Botox and Microbotox](https://oneplacewellness.com/#treatments): forehead lines, frown lines, crow's feet and neck bands; Microbotox calms fine movements around the mouth and the brow. No anesthetic; tender for an hour or two; full results in 5 to 7 days, still improving at about two weeks; lasts 3 to 6 months. Every first treatment comes with a complimentary 30-unit booster two weeks later. Products: Botox, Xeomin.
- [Fillers](https://oneplacewellness.com/#treatments): nasolabial folds, lines around the lips, lips, cheeks, jawline and jowls (jowl reduction is Dr. Fox's specialty); definition along the jaw can lift the neck (a liquid face lift). Many people expect fillers to last 6 to 12 months; Restylane lasts up to 18 months, and fillers can last much longer. Products: Juvederm (Voluma XC, Ultra XC, Volbella XC), Restylane, Radiesse, Sculptra, Revance.
- [Threadlift, Silhouette InstaLift®](https://oneplacewellness.com/#treatments): 45 minutes under local anesthetic; Dr. Fox marks where each suture will go; an immediate lift of the mid-face, then volume builds as the sutures stimulate collagen; minor soreness, swelling or bruising; most patients are back to their routine within days. The maker reports results lasting up to two years; many of Dr. Fox's patients have kept theirs longer.
- [ThermiSmooth](https://oneplacewellness.com/#treatments): temperature-controlled radiofrequency for jowls, loose neck skin, neck bands, the jawline and the arms. No downtime; three treatments are recommended; a first difference after the first treatment; final results at 3 to 6 months; lasts a year or longer, with one maintenance treatment every 9 to 12 months. Subtle, not a facelift.
- [Sciton MicroLaser Peel](https://oneplacewellness.com/#treatments): the practice calls it the weekend procedure. Numbing cream 30 minutes before, about 15 minutes of laser with cool air; more than 98% of patients are healed in 3 days. Fine lines, sun spots and pigmentation, texture, tone, acne scars, rosacea and melasma, on the face, neck, hands, chest and shoulders, and sun spots on the legs. Stop retinoids 3 days before.
- [Medical skincare](https://oneplacewellness.com/#treatments): the daily part of the plan, at home, with Obagi and SkinCeuticals; a retinol (vitamin A) product supports ThermiSmooth and the laser.

## Cases

- [What patients asked for, and what she did](https://oneplacewellness.com/#cases): 16 cases from the practice's before-and-after gallery, each with the patient's age when given, her wish, the product, the amount and where it went. For example: 69 years old, 3 cc of Restylane in the cheeks and marionette lines and 1 cc in the lips; 42 years old, Xeomin in the frown lines; 8 Silhouette InstaLift sutures in 45 minutes, to avoid a facelift.
